name: Stock & Crypto Ticker
description: Displays stock tickers with prices, changes, and optional charts for stocks and cryptocurrencies. Supports scroll and switch display modes.
author: LEDMatrix Team

api_requirements.name: Yahoo Finance API
api_requirements.description: Yahoo Finance API for stock and cryptocurrency data

versions.notes: Bitmap fonts and documentation. A .bdf face exists at exactly one pixel size, so choosing 5x7.bdf or 4x6.bdf at any other size raised inside FreeType and the renderer silently substituted PressStart2P; they now load at their own declared size. cozette.bdf is removed from all six font menus because the core ships no such file, so it could never load (#387). The README gains real rendered screenshots -- a gain, a loss, a crypto entry, both display modes, the inline chart on and off, and four panel sizes -- and documents the eight per-element colour keys that were previously summarised in a sentence.

Accept the symbols Yahoo actually serves. The field was validated against ^\^?[A-Z]{1,5}$ -- letters only -- so a commodity (GC=F gold, CL=F crude), a share class (BRK-B), a non-US listing (7203.T) or an index containing a digit (^N225) was rejected at the config form and never reached the API. Nothing else validated symbols and the fetcher passes them through verbatim, so the pattern was the only obstacle: every one of those returns live data from the endpoint this plugin already calls. Indexes with a plain caret (^GSPC, ^DJI, ^VIX) were always accepted and still are. Crypto is no longer hard-coded to USD either -- BTC-EUR previously became BTC-EUR-USD, which has no data; a symbol with no quote currency is still sent as -USD. The README documents each form with worked examples.

Pixel-perfect text: all draw surfaces in the display and chart renderers now render with anti-aliasing off, so custom font sizes stay hard-edged on the LED grid. Default sizes were already on the font's pixel grid, so the default look is unchanged.

Stock ticker layout overhaul so entries stay compact on large/4x panels and in vegas mode. The mini-chart is now a definite pixel size (chart_width_px / chart_height_px, default 64x32) instead of a fraction of the display, so it no longer balloons on wide chains or tall panels. The chart sits directly to the right of the price (no large gap), and each entry canvas is sized to its actual content so there is no dead space between tickers. Replaces the chart_width_percent / chart_height_percent config keys.
Add display.chart_width_percent and display.chart_height_percent so the inline mini-chart's size is user configurable instead of hardcoded fractions of the entry canvas.
Bump logo_x (2px→4px) and logo_gap (4px→8px) so the ~26px-tall logo isn't cramped against the display edge and the symbol/price text on the 32px-tall display.

Set the license to GPL-3.0 (project standard; the LICENSE file was already GPL, the manifest field said MIT). Guard the display_manager.process_deferred_updates() call with hasattr so the plugin renders under display managers that don't implement it (e.g. the plugin-safety harness).
